entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit lost with the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Could you please provide me with your order number to start?
Oh, sure. It's... VF886-04. I bought some cycling shoes, and it's just not working out.
Thank you. I have your order right here for the ProFit cycling shoes. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?

Well, they just hurt so much. I tried them on a ride and got these awful blisters on my heels. I don't know if I installed the cleats wrong or something... the instructions were so confusing. I just know I can't wear them. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing you blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay... I hope it's okay. I've had them for a little while.
Alright, I've pulled up the details. I see you received the item 47 days ago. According to our policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was stuck with them. That's a huge relief.

Not at all. I can absolutely process this return for you. I'm generating a pre-paid return label and emailing it to you right now. Just place the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any local post office.
That's wonderful, thank you so much, Alex!
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the return, your full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
